chunks: That day they will follow the summoner from whom there will be no receding; and their voices will be hushed before Ar-Rahman, and you will not hear a sound but faint shuffling.

key_terms.الدَّاعِيَ: The Summoner (God or the Angel of Trumpet)

ai.seo_question: What happens to the voices of people on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Al-Da'i' is often interpreted as the Prophet Muhammad or the Imams, whose guidance is perfectly straight and free from the distortions of worldly desires. The subduing of voices reflects the universal humility of creation before Allah, emphasizing that true worship involves both outward submission and inward tranquility, a state where the noise of ego is replaced by the quiet reverence of the faithful.
